text:
maria: opened a docs PR to clarify async batching semantics and add a compact v3->v4 SDK migration snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7510
ajay: which files?
maria: model-catalog/limits.md (batching anchors + seq table), model-cards/nebula3b.md (compat row), model-cards/polaris13b.md (bench update), examples/sdk-migration.md (v3/v4 examples). Branch: docs/async-batch-7510.
sasha: dropping quick bench notes in thread.
sasha: polaris13b fp16, batch_window=20ms, batch=4 => p50 ~45ms, p99 ~120ms. nebula3b q4_0 cold start +80ms, steady ~40ms.
olivia: note: snippet used old client.call(); should show client.generate() and mention batch_window is milliseconds in v4.
ben: avoid exact token counts in example outputs; use "~n tokens".
docbot: lint: missing anchor for batch_window cross-ref in limits.md.
maria: will add anchor and update snippets. Olivia, can you edit examples?
olivia: will push side-by-side v3->v4 examples and a TL;DR. Also add a one-liner about CPU fallback on quantized models.
ajay: add small compatibility fields on each card: "CPU fallback: yes/no" and "quantized determinism: low/med/high".
maria: added rows to Nebula and Polaris. Pushed updated commit.
ben: copy pass done. changed fixed token numbers to "~n tokens".
ajay: approving pending CI.
docbot: CI passed.

maria: merged. follow-up: add heuristics table for batch_window in a follow-up PR if needed.
